title: Fold-key collisions: orphans byId and projection taskKeys (post-0.15.1)
description: From the #756 round-1 verdict (LCLI-809), S3. Two tasks (or an id and an alias) that fold to one referenceKey overwrite each other: src/commands/orphans.ts byId (last one wins in the parent walk) and src/core/projection.ts taskKeys (both task records get the same key). The fold catches more ids than toLowerCase did. Decide the policy (refuse and name both, or a deterministic winner reported) and test it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Two tasks folding to one key are reported or refused deterministically in orphans and in projection, each with a test red without the change
